            (rp (grob-interpret-markup grob (markup #:teeny ")"))))

                    (cons (car (ly:stencil-extent rp X))
                          (cdr (last cp))))
         (ly:grob-set-property! grob 'control-points cp)
         (apply ly:stencil-add (list lp rp
                                     (ly:slur::print grob)))))
